full_text:
Question 11 - Consent

The Office for Civil Rights (OCR) is required by law to have your written consent (permission) before we can use your name or other identifying information about you to investigate your complaint.

We may need to reveal your name or other identifying information about you to people at the entity you are complaining about or other agencies. For example, to find out about your treatment, we may need to share your name and your complaint with people at the medical center or office where you received services.

If you do not give us your consent, we will likely have to close your complaint because we will not be able to investigate the facts of your case.

You may give your consent by checking the box below.

[ ] I give OCR my consent to reveal my identity and other personal information about me to people at the entity I am complaining about and other agencies, as necessary to investigate my complaint.

Signature: __________________________ Date: __________________________
